breakdown.description: The given relative velocities/angles imply different axial components, contradicting the statement that axial velocity is constant.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the given values contradict the condition of constant axial velocity. However, it did not resolve the issue. The ground truth resolves the inconsistency by recalculating W2 based on a constant axial velocity derived from the inlet conditions. The agent, instead of correcting the prompt to make it solvable, simply pointed out the error and stated not to proceed. This fails to meet the goal of creating a correct, solvable prompt.
